pages.text: After 20 seconds under the open sky you get cold: 15% slower.$(br2)$(l)Warm up:$() stand within 4 blocks of a lit campfire, fire, lava, magma or a lit furnace; go under any roof; or eat (45 s of warmth).
Each piece of leather armour gives 10 more seconds before you get cold; a full leather set keeps you warm all night.$(br2)Blocks, water and crops never freeze.
